plate_findings.evidence: The common bile duct measures 10.5 mm proximally (top image)

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (A, B). A: Top MRCP image from an article titled on AIDS cholangiopathy shows a dilated proximal common bile duct measured at 10.5 mm, matching the vocabulary finding of CBD dilatation; no skin or demographic data provided. B: Bottom MRCP image shows the distal common bile duct (7.2 mm) with smooth tapering to the ampulla, a dilated extrahepatic duct in the setting of AIDS cholangiopathy; caption does not specify papillary stenosis for this panel, so no subtype is assigned.

panels.figure_caption: The common bile duct measures 10.5 mm proximally (top image), and 7.2 mm distally (bottom image). The common bile duct demonstrates a relatively smooth, tapering appearance to the ampulla of Vater.
